body:
## What this listing is

This is Localrent's car hire page for France. Localrent lists cars from local rental companies, so the choice depends on who is active in the country. The page shows 4 cars when we searched, with a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 4,509 reviews, which is Localrent's figure for the whole service.

## What the filters showed

The page's filters gave these counts for France:

- No credit card needed: 4 cars

The counts change with your dates and pick-up point, so run your own search to see what is available.

## A sample price

The lowest-priced car we saw was a Renault Clio, 34.71$ per day or 485.88$ for 14 days, new car with unlimited mileage and instant booking; basic cover 3.36$, full cover 20.16$. These prices are for the dates we searched and for one car model, so they are a guide, not a quote.

## What else the page says

The listing is small: only four cars were available for the dates we searched, all Renault Clio, so it will not suit every date or pick-up. Each car card also shows its cover: minimum and basic cover are free of charge on many listings, while full cover is available at an extra daily charge on some and unavailable on others.

## What to check

Look at the mileage limit, because some cars carry a daily cap and others state unlimited mileage. Check the deposit and the cancellation terms on the specific car, since they differ from one local company to another. Localrent shows photos for only some cars, so read the description before you book.

## When it fits

It suits a short trip in the places Localrent covers, where a local supplier with no credit card requirement is useful; widen your search with other providers if the dates do not fit. If you need a pick-up outside the places Localrent lists, compare it with the other providers on this site's car rental page.
